name: Pressure Sign
findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 456 current-evidence enrichment: 100-Ki Strike Super and universal counter obtained through the Skill Shop. During the taunt/counter window, an incoming attack causes the user to teleport behind the attacker and kick; the resulting knockback can be followed by some sufficiently fast supers. Current evidence supports universal-counter classification and rapid kick behavior; exact counter frames and damage scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
